typescript_sql_authorities.description: The shipped SDK runtime graph cannot contain the retired synchronous SQLite authority.

typescript_sql_drivers.description: The shipped SDK runtime graph cannot import a TypeScript SQLite driver.

typescript_query_projection_mutators.description: Queries cannot invoke projection ensure/rebuild work.

source_specific_runtime_services.description: The shipped SDK runtime graph cannot contain source-local lifecycle, watcher, parser, or checkpoint services.

rust_common_source_dispatch.description: Default Rust common modules cannot branch on a built-in adapter or depend on one concretely.

rust_legacy_oracle_default_exposure.description: The retired Rust bulk/live writer must stay behind a non-default repository-only feature and out of generated production bindings.

rust_source_boundary_violations.description: The common Rust source layer cannot depend on vendor adapters, the Spaghetti engine/store, N-API, or JSON decoders.

rust_adapter_storage_boundary_violations.description: Rust adapter contracts and vendor adapters cannot depend on Spaghetti storage, writer/event internals, orchestration, or N-API.

rfc012_adapter_access_authority_violatio.description: Adapters may declare source/scope bounds but cannot construct access budgets, mint object tokens, or reserve native access.

rfc012_semantic_boundary_violations.description: The RFC 012A base semantic model cannot depend on adapters, sources, persistence, queries, observation delivery, N-API, or concrete agents.

rfc012_support_boundary_violations.description: RFC 012A support selection and contract negotiation cannot inspect sources, depend on topology or persistence, or acquire runtime authority itself.

rfc012_adapter_support_binding_gaps.description: Every built-in adapter must declare a package/decoder/ADS/source/scope digest binding that can be checked against a verified support release.

rfc012_scoped_host_boundary_violations.description: The provisional store-free scoped composition root cannot depend on persistence, N-API, concrete adapters, or become a public host contract before RFC 012D freezes it.

rfc012_decode_runtime_boundary_violation.description: The shared RFC 012 decode runtime cannot depend on persistence, delivery sinks, N-API, scoped orchestration, or concrete adapters.

rfc012_coverage_crate_boundary_violation.description: Coverage membership encoding lives in spaghetti-coverage and cannot acquire SQLite, N-API, or engine/adapter authority.

rfc012_catalog_contract_boundary_violati.description: The catalog is durable engine state reached through generated N-API bindings. A separate catalog contract module in Rust or TypeScript would be a second authority and is forbidden.

rfc012_semantic_contract_boundary_violat.description: RFC 012A/012C fixture JSON parsers stay store-free, and the N-API helpers remain JSON-string only without becoming a public query or object-mirror surface.

migrated_client_direct_engine_queries.description: Consumers already migrated to SpaghettiClient may keep native engine lifecycle ownership but cannot resume direct N-API query calls.

portable_client_runtime_boundary_violati.description: The portable client entry used outside the owner process can import the closed store-free RFC 012B contract graph but cannot runtime-import storage, watchers, embedded N-API, or other unresolved modules.

playground_main_sdk_owner_bypasses.description: Electron main and preload may import the portable client but cannot runtime-import the owner SDK bundle with SQLite, watchers, and N-API.

observation_host_runtime_boundary_violat.description: The native observation host runtime graph may consume the closed store-free RFC 012B contract graph but cannot import TypeScript source readers, watchers, native-file parsers, SQLite/schema, or projection writers.

react_synchronous_query_bypasses.description: Published React and Electron renderer code cannot restore synchronous database snapshots or the repository-only legacy API.

sdk_package_boundary_gaps.description: The SDK build must roll declarations from public entries and reject legacy ownership leaks in the built artifact.
